name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
description: Gemini Notebook is Google's notebook tool for working with your own sources; Google's site now uses this name (the notebooklm.google address redirects to notebook.google). Answers are grounded in the sources you add, and it can produce Audio Overviews and slide decks. It has a free Standard tier and higher limits through Google AI plans.
features: Higher notebook and source limits on Google AI plans
useCases: Studying and summarising your own documents
strengths: Free tier with a Google account
Included with qualifying Google Workspace and Google AI plans
limitations: Free tier: 100 notebooks per user and 50 sources per notebook
Some paid tiers add a visible watermark in India, South Korea and Vietnam

plans.name: Google AI Plus
plans.note: 200 notebooks and 100 sources per notebook. Price not captured here: see Gemini

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.note: 500 notebooks and 300 sources per notebook. Price not captured here: see Gemini

plans.name: Google AI Ultra (20 TB / 30 TB)
plans.note: 500 notebooks and 500 or 600 sources per notebook. Price not captured here

free.details: Standard tier by signing up with a Gmail account: 100 notebooks per user and 50 sources per notebook.

pricing.regional: Plus, Pro and Ultra browser access depends on where the corresponding Google AI plan is available. The mobile app lists supported countries separately.
notes: Also available with qualifying Google Workspace or Workspace for Education licences and through Gemini Enterprise; limits not stated for those.

verification.notes: Product active but renamed: notebooklm.google now redirects to notebook.google, titled 'Gemini Notebook', and the help page is 'Learn about Gemini Notebook's plans'. The Standard tier is free with a Gmail account; Plus, Pro and Ultra tiers come with Google AI plans (see Gemini for the Pakistan prices of Plus and Pro). Notebook and source limits per tier were not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: A research and thinking partner that answers from the sources you give it

capabilities.title: Ask about anything in your sources
capabilities.text: Responses are always grounded in the information you provide.

capabilities.title: Listen to a summary
capabilities.text: Audio Overviews read a summary of your sources aloud, with interactive options.

capabilities.title: Learn from public notebooks
capabilities.text: Featured public notebooks let you ask questions and generate summaries to see how others use it.

capabilities.title: Use your notes more efficiently
capabilities.text: The site says the product exists so you can use your notes more efficiently.

featureCards.name: Grounded answers
featureCards.text: The product answers from the documents in a notebook.

featureCards.name: Audio Overviews
featureCards.text: A spoken summary of your sources.

featureCards.name: Featured public notebooks
featureCards.text: Starter notebooks such as the complete works of Shakespeare and a set of corporate earnings reports.

featureCards.name: Built with Gemini models
featureCards.text: The site says it is built with the latest Gemini models.

featureCards.name: Privacy stance
featureCards.text: Organisation and school data is never used to train the models, and individual data is not used unless you share feedback.

featureCards.name: Renamed
featureCards.text: The site now calls the product Gemini Notebook and has an FAQ asking whether it is the same product as NotebookLM.

audienceDetail.text: Personal users are covered by the privacy statement.
The site names schools as organisations whose data stays private.
Company data is stated not to train the models.

scenarios.title: Study a large body of text
scenarios.text: A public notebook holds the complete works of Shakespeare as dozens of sources.

scenarios.title: Digest a pile of reports
scenarios.text: A public notebook covers earnings reports for 50 large corporations across hundreds of sources.

scenarios.title: Follow a theme across articles
scenarios.text: A public notebook gathers sources on healthy ageing.

gettingStarted.text: Use the button on the site.
Notebooks are built from the information you provide.
Or open a featured public notebook to see how it works.
